gloss: to leave in writing; to write down for posterity

definitions.gloss: to leave in writing; to write down for posterity; to record
definitions.explanation: To write something so that it remains as a record after one is gone or for future reference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: I left it written in my diary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{書|か}き{残|のこ}した⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A letter that my grandfather left behind was found.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{後世|こうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{残|のこ}そう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He decided to write down his experiences for future generations.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) and ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (to leave behind). It emphasizes that the writing survives or endures, often implying the author has since passed away or that the record is meant for posterity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{残|のこ}す: to leave a written record
- ⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{残|のこ}す: to leave a will in writing
- {後世|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{残|のこ}す: to write down for posterity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記|しる}す→記す：14238_shirusu⟧: to write down; to record — more literary, focuses on the act of recording
- ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave behind — broader, not limited to writing
- ⟦{書|か}き{留|と}める→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧: to jot down; to note — focuses on capturing information in the moment
